```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
})

# -----------------------------
# Inputs
# -----------------------------
freq_rds <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"
meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/ATGC_only/heatmap"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

top_sites <- c("liver", "brain", "bone")

# -----------------------------
# Load
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  )

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Restrict to top sites + ATGC-only motifs
# -----------------------------
df_site <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites)),
    end_motif = toupper(str_trim(end_motif))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites) %>%
  filter(!grepl("[^ATGC]", end_motif)) %>%               # ATGC-only
  filter(is.finite(freq.corrected))                      # drop NA/Inf

# confirm n samples
site_n <- df_site %>%
  distinct(id, metastatic_sites) %>%
  count(metastatic_sites, sort = TRUE)

message("Cohort sizes:")
print(site_n)
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Build matrix: rows=motifs (256), cols=samples (89)
# -----------------------------
# Make sure each (id, end_motif) has ONE value (it should)
df_mat <- df_site %>%
  select(id, metastatic_sites, end_motif, freq.corrected) %>%
  distinct()

# If duplicates exist, aggregate (safe)
df_mat <- df_mat %>%
  group_by(id, metastatic_sites, end_motif) %>%
  summarise(freq.corrected = sum(freq.corrected), .groups = "drop")

# Wide matrix
wide <- df_mat %>%
  select(id, end_motif, freq.corrected) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = id, values_from = freq.corrected)

motifs <- wide$end_motif
mat <- as.matrix(wide %>% select(-end_motif))
rownames(mat) <- motifs

# Ensure columns (samples) are ordered by site (liver/brain/bone)
sample_site <- df_mat %>%
  distinct(id, metastatic_sites)

# order samples by site, then by id
site_levels <- c("liver", "brain", "bone")
sample_site <- sample_site %>%
  mutate(metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = site_levels)) %>%
  arrange(metastatic_sites, id)

mat <- mat[, sample_site$id, drop = FALSE]

# Sanity checks
message("Matrix dim (motifs x samples): ", paste(dim(mat), collapse = " x "))
message("Unique motifs: ", nrow(mat))
message("Unique samples: ", ncol(mat))
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Z-score by motif (row-wise)
# -----------------------------
# This matches typical motif heatmaps: relative enrichment/depletion per motif
z_row <- function(x) {
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / s
}
zmat <- t(apply(mat, 1, z_row))
rownames(zmat) <- rownames(mat)
colnames(zmat) <- colnames(mat)

# clip extremes so colors look like the paper
zmat[zmat >  4] <-  4
zmat[zmat < -4] <- -4

# -----------------------------
# Top annotation bar
# -----------------------------
site_vec <- sample_site$metastatic_sites
names(site_vec) <- sample_site$id

ha_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Site = site_vec,
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  col = list(
    Site = c(
      liver = "#1b9e77",
      brain = "#7570b3",
      bone  = "#d95f02"
    )
  ),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Site = list(title = "Metastatic site")
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# Heatmap
# -----------------------------
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-4, 0, 4), c("#2c105c", "white", "#fdb863"))

ht <- Heatmap(
  zmat,
  name = "Z",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = ha_top,

  # hide labels
  show_row_names = FALSE,     
  show_column_names = FALSE,

  # clustering
  cluster_rows = FALSE,        
  cluster_columns = TRUE,      
  column_title = NULL          
)


# -----------------------------
# Save PNG + PDF
# -----------------------------
png_file <- file.path(outdir, "endmotif_heatmap_ATGC_top3sites.png")
pdf_file <- file.path(outdir, "endmotif_heatmap_ATGC_top3sites.pdf")

# PNG (high-res)
png(png_file, width = 2400, height = 3400, res = 300)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

# PDF (vector)
pdf(pdf_file, width = 8.5, height = 11)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

message("Saved: ", png_file)
message("Saved: ", pdf_file)
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# OPTIONAL: save row cluster membership (which motif belongs to cluster 1/2/3)
# Useful for downstream interpretation
# -----------------------------
# ComplexHeatmap calculates splits internally; to export clusters robustly,
# we re-compute the row dendrogram and cut into 3 groups:
row_hc <- hclust(dist(zmat), method = "complete")
row_cluster <- cutree(row_hc, k = 3)
cluster_df <- data.frame(end_motif = names(row_cluster), motif_cluster = row_cluster) %>%
  arrange(motif_cluster, end_motif)

write_csv(cluster_df, file.path(outdir, "motif_clusters_k3_ATGC.csv"))
message("Saved motif clusters: ", file.path(outdir, "motif_clusters_k3_ATGC.csv"))

```

```{r}
# visualization of 1-mer end motif frequencies stratified by Sites

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
freq_rds <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"
meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/ATGC_only/one_mer"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Order used in plots (brain -> bone -> liver)
top_sites <- c("brain", "bone", "liver")

# -----------------------------
# Load inputs
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

df_site <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites)),
    end_motif = toupper(str_trim(end_motif))
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("[^ATGC]", end_motif)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(freq.corrected), is.finite(freq))

cat("Cohort sizes (single-site top sites):\n")
print(df_site %>% distinct(id, metastatic_sites) %>% count(metastatic_sites, sort = TRUE))
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Collapse 4-mers -> 1-mer
# -----------------------------
df_1mer <- df_site %>%
  mutate(end_motif_1mer = str_sub(end_motif, 1, 1)) %>%
  group_by(id, metastatic_sites, end_motif_1mer) %>%
  summarise(
    freq = sum(freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    freq.corrected = sum(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    end_motif_1mer = factor(end_motif_1mer, levels = c("A", "C", "G", "T")),
    metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = top_sites)
  )

check_sum <- df_1mer %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(sum_freq_corrected = sum(freq.corrected), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nSanity check: sum of 1-mer freq.corrected per sample (should be ~1):\n")
print(summary(check_sum$sum_freq_corrected))

saveRDS(df_1mer, file.path(outdir, "endmotif_1mer_freq_per_sample_top3sites.rds"))
write_tsv(df_1mer, file.path(outdir, "endmotif_1mer_freq_per_sample_top3sites.tsv.gz"))
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Stats
# -----------------------------
res_kw <- df_1mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_1mer) %>%
  kruskal_test(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

res_eff <- df_1mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_1mer) %>%
  kruskal_effsize(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  arrange(desc(effsize))

res_pairwise <- df_1mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_1mer) %>%
  wilcox_test(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  arrange(end_motif_1mer, p.adj)

write_csv(res_kw, file.path(outdir, "res_1mer_kw_top_sites.csv"))
write_csv(res_eff, file.path(outdir, "res_1mer_effsize_top_sites.csv"))
write_csv(res_pairwise, file.path(outdir, "res_1mer_pairwise_wilcox_top_sites.csv"))

cat("\nKW results:\n"); print(res_kw)
cat("\nEffect sizes:\n"); print(res_eff)

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
site_cols <- c(brain = "#4DBBD5", bone = "#E64B35", liver = "#00A087")

p <- ggplot(df_1mer, aes(x = metastatic_sites, y = freq.corrected, fill = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.1,
    color = "black"   
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ end_motif_1mer, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site (single-site only)",
    y = "1-mer end motif frequency (GC-corrected)",
    title = "1-mer end motif frequencies stratified by metastatic site"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# -----------------------------
# Add ONE smallest BH-adjusted pairwise p-value per facet
# -----------------------------
res_pairwise_min <- res_pairwise %>%
  group_by(end_motif_1mer) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p.adj, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

ypos_df <- df_1mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_1mer) %>%
  summarise(y.position = max(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08, .groups = "drop")

res_pairwise_min <- res_pairwise_min %>%
  left_join(ypos_df, by = "end_motif_1mer")

# If you want NO p-values, comment this block out
p <- p + ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
  res_pairwise_min,
  label = "p.adj",
  tip.length = 0.01,
  hide.ns = TRUE
)

# -----------------------------
# Save
# -----------------------------
png_file <- file.path(outdir, "plot_1mer_by_site_freq_corrected.png")
pdf_file <- file.path(outdir, "plot_1mer_by_site_freq_corrected.pdf")

ggsave(png_file, plot = p, width = 11, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave(pdf_file, plot = p, width = 11, height = 4)

cat("\nSaved plot:\n", png_file, "\n", pdf_file, "\n")
cat("Outputs in:\n", outdir, "\n")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)

})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
freq_rds <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"
meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/ATGC_only/two_mer"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Order used in plots (brain -> bone -> liver)
top_sites <- c("brain", "bone", "liver")

# -----------------------------
# Load inputs
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

df_site <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites)),
    end_motif = toupper(str_trim(end_motif))
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("[^ATGC]", end_motif)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(freq.corrected), is.finite(freq))

cat("Cohort sizes (single-site top sites):\n")
print(df_site %>% distinct(id, metastatic_sites) %>% count(metastatic_sites, sort = TRUE))

# -----------------------------
# Collapse 4-mers -> 2-mer (first 2 bases)
# -----------------------------
df_2mer <- df_site %>%
  mutate(end_motif_2mer = str_sub(end_motif, 1, 2)) %>%
  group_by(id, metastatic_sites, end_motif_2mer) %>%
  summarise(
    freq = sum(freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    freq.corrected = sum(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # all possible 2-mers in a fixed order (AA, AC, ..., TT)
    end_motif_2mer = factor(
      end_motif_2mer,
      levels = as.vector(outer(c("A","C","G","T"), c("A","C","G","T"), paste0))
    ),
    metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = top_sites)
  )

# Optional sanity: sum ~1 per sample for 2-mers
check_sum <- df_2mer %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(sum_freq_corrected = sum(freq.corrected), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nSanity check: sum of 2-mer freq.corrected per sample (should be ~1):\n")
print(summary(check_sum$sum_freq_corrected))

# Save collapsed table
saveRDS(df_2mer, file.path(outdir, "endmotif_2mer_freq_per_sample_top3sites.rds"))
write_tsv(df_2mer, file.path(outdir, "endmotif_2mer_freq_per_sample_top3sites.tsv.gz"))

# -----------------------------
# Stats
# -----------------------------
res_kw <- df_2mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_2mer) %>%
  kruskal_test(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

res_eff <- df_2mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_2mer) %>%
  kruskal_effsize(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  arrange(desc(effsize))

res_pairwise <- df_2mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_2mer) %>%
  wilcox_test(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  arrange(end_motif_2mer, p.adj)

write_csv(res_kw, file.path(outdir, "res_2mer_kw_top_sites.csv"))
write_csv(res_eff, file.path(outdir, "res_2mer_effsize_top_sites.csv"))
write_csv(res_pairwise, file.path(outdir, "res_2mer_pairwise_wilcox_top_sites.csv"))

cat("\nKW results (top hits):\n")
print(res_kw %>% slice_head(n = 10))

cat("\nEffect sizes (top hits):\n")
print(res_eff %>% slice_head(n = 10))

# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
site_cols <- c(brain = "#4DBBD5", bone = "#E64B35", liver = "#00A087")

p <- ggplot(df_2mer, aes(x = metastatic_sites, y = freq.corrected, fill = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ end_motif_2mer, ncol = 8, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site (single-site only)",
    y = "2-mer end motif frequency (GC-corrected)",
    title = "2-mer end motif frequencies stratified by metastatic site"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Add ONE smallest BH-adjusted pairwise p-value per facet
# (optional; comment out if too busy for 16 panels)
# -----------------------------
res_pairwise_min <- res_pairwise %>%
  group_by(end_motif_2mer) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p.adj, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

ypos_df <- df_2mer %>%
  group_by(end_motif_2mer) %>%
  summarise(y.position = max(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08, .groups = "drop")

res_pairwise_min <- res_pairwise_min %>%
  left_join(ypos_df, by = "end_motif_2mer")

p <- p + ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
  res_pairwise_min,
  label = "p.adj",
  tip.length = 0.01,
  hide.ns = TRUE,
  size = 2.6
)

print(p)

# -----------------------------
# Save
# -----------------------------
png_file <- file.path(outdir, "plot_2mer_by_site_freq_corrected.png")
pdf_file <- file.path(outdir, "plot_2mer_by_site_freq_corrected.pdf")

ggsave(png_file, plot = p, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(pdf_file, plot = p, width = 14, height = 8)

cat("\nSaved plot:\n", png_file, "\n", pdf_file, "\n")
cat("Outputs in:\n", outdir, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Representative 4-mer end motif frequencies across metastatic sites
# Motifs selected by largest effect size (strength of bias)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rstatix)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
freq_rds <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"

meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

kw_res_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/ATGC_only/res_4bp_kw_top_sites_ATGC.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/figures_boxplot_motifs"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  )

top_sites <- c("liver", "brain", "bone")

df_site <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

# -----------------------------
# Select representative motifs
# -----------------------------
kw_res <- read_csv(kw_res_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Pick top motifs by effect size (Î·Â²)
top_motifs <- kw_res %>%
  arrange(desc(effsize)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(end_motif)

print(top_motifs)

# -----------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- df_site %>%
  filter(end_motif %in% top_motifs) %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites,
                              levels = c("brain", "bone", "liver"))
  )

# -----------------------------
# Build facet labels with RAW p-values
# -----------------------------
motif_p <- kw_res %>%
  select(end_motif, p) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(p_label = paste0("p=", signif(p, 3))) %>%
  select(end_motif, p_label) %>%   # <-- REQUIRED for deframe()
  deframe()

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    end_motif_facet = factor(
      end_motif,
      levels = top_motifs,
      labels = paste0(top_motifs, " (", motif_p[top_motifs], ")")
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# Boxplot
# -----------------------------
p <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = metastatic_sites,
    y = freq.corrected,
    fill = metastatic_sites
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ end_motif_facet, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      brain = "#4DBBD5",
      bone  = "#E64B35",
      liver = "#00A087"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site (single-site only)",
    y = "GC-corrected 4-mer end motif frequency",
    title = "Representative 4-mer end motif frequencies across metastatic sites",
    subtitle = "Motifs selected by largest effect size (raw Kruskalâ€“Wallis p-values shown)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p)

# -----------------------------
# Save
# -----------------------------
ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "boxplot_4mer_representative_ATGC_effect_size.png"),
  p,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "boxplot_4mer_representative_ATGC_effect_size.pdf"),
  p,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)
```

```{r}
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

top_sites <- c("brain", "bone", "liver")  # plotting order

# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

df_site <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites)),
    end_motif = toupper(str_trim(end_motif))
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("[^ATGC]", end_motif)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(freq.corrected))

cat("Cohort sizes:\n")
print(df_site %>% distinct(id, metastatic_sites) %>% count(metastatic_sites, sort = TRUE))

# -----------------------------
# Pick TOP 3 motifs GLOBALLY by median frequency (baseline cleavage)
# -----------------------------
motif_global <- df_site %>%
  group_by(end_motif) %>%
  summarise(
    global_med = median(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_med))

top3_motifs <- motif_global %>% slice_head(n = 3) %>% pull(end_motif)

cat("\nTop 3 global motifs by median freq.corrected:\n")
print(motif_global %>% filter(end_motif %in% top3_motifs))

# -----------------------------
# Plotting DF
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- df_site %>%
  filter(end_motif %in% top3_motifs) %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = top_sites),
    end_motif = factor(end_motif, levels = top3_motifs)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Stats (per motif): KW + pairwise Wilcox
# -----------------------------
res_kw <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(end_motif) %>%
  kruskal_test(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  mutate(p_label = paste0("KW p=", signif(p, 3), ", BH=", signif(p.adj, 3))) %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

res_pairwise <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(end_motif) %>%
  wilcox_test(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  arrange(end_motif, p.adj)

write_csv(res_kw, file.path(outdir, "top3_global_motifs_KW.csv"))
write_csv(res_pairwise, file.path(outdir, "top3_global_motifs_pairwise_wilcox.csv"))

# put KW p-value into facet label
motif_to_label <- res_kw %>%
  select(end_motif, p_label) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  deframe()

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    end_motif_facet = factor(
      end_motif,
      levels = top3_motifs,
      labels = paste0(top3_motifs, " (", motif_to_label[top3_motifs], ")")
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = metastatic_sites, y = freq.corrected, fill = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.1, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ end_motif_facet, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(brain = "#4DBBD5", bone = "#E64B35", liver = "#00A087")) +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site (single-site only)",
    y = "GC-corrected 4-mer end motif frequency",
    title = "Top 3 global 4-mer end motifs across metastatic sites",
    subtitle = "Motifs selected by global median frequency (baseline cleavage preference)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p)

# -----------------------------
# Save
# -----------------------------
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "boxplot_top3_global_4mer_ATGC.png"),
       p, width = 11, height = 4, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "boxplot_top3_global_4mer_ATGC.pdf"),
       p, width = 11, height = 4)

cat("\nSaved:\n", file.path(outdir, "boxplot_top3_global_4mer_ATGC.png"), "\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "boxplot_top3_global_4mer_ATGC.pdf"), "\n")
cat("Stats CSVs saved in:\n", outdir, "\n")
```
